ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Script Execution From Temp Folder
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a suspicious script executions from temporary folder

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\mshta\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wscript\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cscript\\\.exe$")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\Temp.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Temporary\\ Internet.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Roaming\\\\Temp.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\%TEMP\\%.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\%TMP\\%.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\%LocalAppData\\%\\\\Temp.*"))) AND  NOT ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\>.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Out\\-File.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*ConvertTo\\-Json.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-WindowStyle\\ hidden\\ \\-Verb\\ runAs.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\system32\\\\config\\\\systemprofile\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\Amazon\\\\EC2\\-Windows\\\\.*")))
